t: A free beginner Java environment that also supports the Stride language.
steps: Choose the MSI, dmg, deb, or JAR file for each computer.
Check that computers run 64-bit Windows 8 or later, macOS 11 or later, or Debian 11 or Ubuntu 20.04 or later.
Ask IT to approve the install on school devices.
Decide whether to turn off the optional Blackbox data collection.
Create a small project and run it.
Try the standalone Windows zip on a USB drive for shared machines.
